preconditions.description: The number of elements in the set S is between 1 and 31, inclusive.
Each element in the set S is between 0 and 30, inclusive.
All elements in the set S are distinct.

postconditions.expression: output == '=((' or (output_is_integer and output >= 1 and output <= 31))
postconditions.description: If there is no such tournament, the output is '=(('. Otherwise, the output is an integer n (the number of vertices in the tournament) followed by n lines with n characters each, representing the adjacency matrix of the tournament.
